description:
Threads Scraper: Profiles, Posts & Replies

Public Threads (threads.com) profiles with followers and bio, their latest posts, and single post pages with visible replies: text, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, media. No login, no browser. $1.00 per 1,000 posts.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Post: $0.001; Profile: $0.002.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/threads-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

includeReplies.description: For each post link, also deliver the replies that the post page shows. Replies are charged as post rows. Only the replies threads.com renders are available; there are no further reply pages.
includeReplies.title: Include visible replies of post links

maxItems.description: Hard cap on charged rows in one run: profile rows plus post and reply rows (1 to 10000). The run stops cleanly when the cap is reached.
maxItems.title: Max rows per run

maxPostsPerProfile.description: How many of a profile's latest posts to deliver (0 to 50). 0 delivers the profile row only. threads.com serves about 15 threads per profile page with no deeper pagination, so asking for more than that does not fetch older posts.
maxPostsPerProfile.title: Posts per profile

maxRepliesPerPost.description: How many visible replies to keep for each post link (0 to 100). 0 turns replies off without changing Include replies.
maxRepliesPerPost.title: Replies per post

postUrls.description: Threads post links such as https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/DeZtp-TkQHh (.net links work too). Each link gives that post plus, when Include replies is on, the replies the page shows. Leave empty to scrape only the profiles above.
postUrls.title: Single post links (optional)

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is the default and works for these pages. Direct requests (turn the proxy off) also returned data when this actor was built. A proxy failure fails the request and never falls back to a direct request.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

usernames.description: Public Threads profiles to read. Any of these forms works: zuck, @zuck, https://www.threads.com/@zuck, https://www.threads.net/@zuck. Each profile gives one profile row plus its latest posts. Give usernames, postUrls, or both.
usernames.title: Threads profiles

name: threads
